titleEn: Painting a Grid With Three Different Colors
title: 用三种不同颜色为网格涂色
summary: 用三色给 m×n 网格涂色，要求上下左右相邻颜色不同，求方案数并取模。
insight: m 至多五，可枚举一列的所有三进制着色并过滤竖向冲突。预计算任意两列逐行颜色不同的兼容关系，然后沿列做状态 DP。
pitfalls: 同列上下不同、相邻列同行也不同
n 可达一千需滚动数组

solutions.title: 合法列状态压缩 DP
solutions.idea: 把二维约束转为合法列之间的转移。
steps: 枚举 0..3^m-1，保留相邻三进制位不同的状态
首列每状态方案一；后续列按兼容状态求和，最终汇总

code.java: class Solution { static final int MOD=1_000_000_007;public int colorTheGrid(int m,int n){List<Integer> states=new ArrayList<>();int limit=1;for(int i=0;i<m;i++)limit*=3;for(int state=0;state<limit;state++){int value=state,previous=-1;boolean valid=true;for(int row=0;row<m;row++){int color=value%3;value/=3;if(color==previous)valid=false;previous=color;}if(valid)states.add(state);}int size=states.size();boolean[][] compatible=new boolean[size][size];for(int i=0;i<size;i++)for(int j=0;j<size;j++){int a=states.get(i),b=states.get(j);compatible[i][j]=true;for(int row=0;row<m;row++){if(a%3==b%3)compatible[i][j]=false;a/=3;b/=3;}}long[] dp=new long[size];Arrays.fill(dp,1);for(int col=1;col<n;col++){long[] next=new long[size];for(int current=0;current<size;current++)for(int previous=0;previous<size;previous++)if(compatible[previous][current])next[current]=(next[current]+dp[previous])%MOD;dp=next;}long answer=0;for(long ways:dp)answer=(answer+ways)%MOD;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun colorTheGrid(m:Int,n:Int):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;var limit=1;repeat(m){limit*=3};val states=(0 until limit).filter{stateValue->var value=stateValue;var previous=-1;var valid=true;repeat(m){val color=value%3;value/=3;if(color==previous)valid=false;previous=color};valid};val compatible=Array(states.size){BooleanArray(states.size)};for(i in states.indices)for(j in states.indices){var a=states[i];var b=states[j];compatible[i][j]=true;repeat(m){if(a%3==b%3)compatible[i][j]=false;a/=3;b/=3}};var dp=LongArray(states.size){1};repeat(n-1){val next=LongArray(states.size);for(current in states.indices)for(previous in states.indices)if(compatible[previous][current])next[current]=(next[current]+dp[previous])%mod;dp=next};return (dp.sum()%mod).toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int colorTheGrid(int m,int n){const long long MOD=1000000007;int limit=1;for(int i=0;i<m;++i)limit*=3;vector<int> states;for(int state=0;state<limit;++state){int value=state,previous=-1;bool valid=true;for(int row=0;row<m;++row){int color=value%3;value/=3;if(color==previous)valid=false;previous=color;}if(valid)states.push_back(state);}int size=states.size();vector<vector<bool>> compatible(size,vector<bool>(size,true));for(int i=0;i<size;++i)for(int j=0;j<size;++j){int a=states[i],b=states[j];for(int row=0;row<m;++row){if(a%3==b%3)compatible[i][j]=false;a/=3;b/=3;}}vector<long long> dp(size,1);for(int col=1;col<n;++col){vector<long long> next(size);for(int current=0;current<size;++current)for(int previous=0;previous<size;++previous)if(compatible[previous][current])next[current]=(next[current]+dp[previous])%MOD;dp.swap(next);}return accumulate(dp.begin(),dp.end(),0LL)%MOD;} };
